catalogCounts.interpretation: Current local validated catalogue; changes remain uncommitted and undeployed.

cities.name: Bengaluru
cities.evidenceClass: route/source discovery only; no verified target parcel geometry
cities.technicalBlocker: temporary endpoint/access blocker; reattempt official route from another network path.
cities.outcome: No parcel polygon/native survey ID verified. Kannada searches surfaced Dishaank and GEPTIS; ordinary requests to official GIS routes timed out and GEPTIS is registration-oriented. This is an access/interface result, not evidence of absence.

cities.name: Chennai
cities.evidenceClass: route/source discovery only; no verified target parcel geometry
cities.technicalBlocker: temporary endpoint/access blocker; resolve urban TSLR hierarchy and verify a published geometry route.
cities.outcome: No Chennai parcel polygon obtained. Tamil searches surfaced TSLR/FMB record services; official eServices/TNGIS/CMDA routes timed out, and available GCC GIS layers were roads/administrative boundaries.

cities.name: Hyderabad
cities.technicalBlocker: select official district/mandal/village and obtain a bounded parcel polygon with stable survey ID.
cities.outcome: Exact WUP target returned an aggregate GHMC polygon with blank Parcel_num and a “to be checked” remark; ULB cadastral and cadastral-point queries returned zero.

cities.name: Ghatkesar
cities.technicalBlocker: adapter needs compatible response format and a successful fresh exact native-ID audit; retain explicit whitespace-ID exclusions.
cities.outcome: Nine bounded cells produced 37 distinct nonblank Parcel_num values; reread geometry hashes matched and ring/overlap checks passed. Native exact-ID reads timed out at 15 seconds, and provider supports JSON/AMF while current adapter requests GeoJSON. Three whitespace-ID Road/Village boundary rows are recorded as a proposed excluded subset; this is not citywide coverage.

cities.name: Ahmedabad
cities.outcome: Final AMC planning plots accepted locally: 132 fresh native references, nine complete source cells, native geometry hashes, absence and proposal binding. Headed UI loaded 9 cells / 132 retained features, selected Sarangpur 18 FP 10 and panned to 12 cells / 221 retained features without warnings or page errors. Title/currentness and citywide completeness are not claimed.

cities.name: Lagos
cities.evidenceClass: target-intersecting candidate polygon geometry; parcel semantics unverified
cities.technicalBlocker: find publisher-described parcel polygon semantics and stable native lot/plan key before proposing a source.
cities.outcome: Public Lagos_Charting layer returned two identical target-intersecting large polygons with null lot/plan fields; a bounded local non-null-field query returned zero. OBJECTIDs are transport IDs. Do not classify these as parcels or citywide absence.

cities.name: Dakar
cities.evidenceClass: route/source discovery only; no verified target parcel geometry
cities.technicalBlocker: obtain an operational official parcel feature service or a bounded extract route with documented native identity.
cities.outcome: French searches found official topographic products and DGID parcel-plan administrative request routes; the old cadastral catalog record timed out/reset. No target parcel endpoint or geometry verified.

cities.name: Antananarivo
cities.evidenceClass: planning/PLOF geometry only; no target-centre feature
cities.technicalBlocker: ask custodian for layer definitions, native IDs, verified coverage and any separate cadastral service.
cities.outcome: Official OITF PLOF/planning route yielded geometry-only local polygons and zero features in the WUP-centre bbox; no parcel attributes/native ID or citywide coverage verified.

cities.name: Nairobi
cities.evidenceClass: anonymous target-area outline geometry; no public ID
cities.technicalBlocker: use only as geometry-only display with provenance unless an open source returns stable IDs without account access.
cities.outcome: Anonymous commercial Nairobi Maps viewport/identify returned polygons, but no attributes or feature IDs; app gates parcel details to paid/admin roles. Not an official registry and no parcel join key verified.

cities.name: Dar es Salaam
cities.technicalBlocker: verify publisher, city coverage and extent containing target before a bounded local parcel-ID query.
cities.outcome: Public ArcGIS candidate has a small extent about 28.7 km northwest of WUP centre; sample is not tied to Dar and target-centre count is zero. Native ParcelNo from nearby candidate is not a target sample.
